summary: Verified fix for custom.js useCustomConfig cached-Promise runtime error. Tested Custom Furniture flow (navigate to /custom-project -> click calc-request-survey-button -> /custom-project/ajukan -> back) 4x per demo role across contractor_buyer, supplier_vendor, designer_creator, admin. Zero pageerror and zero uncaught console errors. request-submit-button present on form. Admin tabs all open without crash. Broad smoke on /, /dashboard, /katalog, /portofolio, /custom-project, /admin all clean.

issues: React warning: empty string passed to attribute — causes browser to re-download page. Not blocking but should pass null instead of ''.

action_items: Optional: in admin-tab-promo image render, guard with src={url || undefined} to silence React empty-src warning.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/lib/custom.js fix is correct: cache stores resolved data, pending holds in-flight promise, catch resets pending. useState(cache) now always returns null or data (never a Promise). resetCustomConfig clears both — good for admin edits.
Minor: in useCustomConfig, if cache exists, useState initializes with it so the useEffect setCfg(cache) early-return is redundant but harmless.
Minor: unrelated — admin promo tab emits 'empty string src' React warning; should pass undefined/null when image is not set.
test_credentials: demo-login buttons on /login for contractor_buyer, supplier_vendor, designer_creator, admin
context_for_next_testing_agent: Promo popup blocks login buttons on first visit — always close via [data-testid=promo-popup-close] before clicking demo-login buttons. 401 console errors on /login (auth probe) are expected and ignorable. The original 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading find)' runtime error on CustomProject/RequestForm no longer reproduces across repeated mounts and role switches.
rca of the issue: RCA already stated by main agent: useCustomConfig previously used useState(cache) where cache was a Promise, so on second mount cfg was a thenable rather than the resolved config, breaking downstream .find/.map in RequestForm & CustomProject. Fix separates cache (resolved data) from pending (in-flight promise) and resets pending on error. Verified by 4x repeat flow across 4 demo roles — zero pageerror.
